title: Machine inventory
description: Registered machines that the supervisor/PXE flow is allowed to install or converge. Keys are unique machine IDs (Phase 6 render script additionally rejects duplicate MACs/hostnames/IPs).

role.description: Determines which PXE template, autoinstall/preseed seed, and Ansible playbook apply to this machine.

mac.description: Normalized lowercase colon-separated MAC address of the boot NIC.

disk_serial.description: Exact disk serial the installer must target. Required for every machine because every role performs a destructive OS installation.

hardware_serial.description: Optional chassis/motherboard serial used as an additional identity check.

vars.description: Role-specific variables consumed by later phases (network_config, storage layout, etc.).
